name: payments/v1
description: Taking money: a gateway plugin describes its payment methods, starts and refunds payments and reads a payment's state; the plugin that asked for the payment — the shop — is told what happened. Core holds every session's state (PAYMENTS.md).

methods.name: describe
methods.description: The payment methods this gateway offers now, for checkout to show.
methods.agent_reason: the owner reaches payments through Core's own payment tools (payments_list, payment_detail, payment_decide, payment_methods, payment_method_set); this hook is Core-to-plugin plumbing beneath them

methods.name: start
methods.description: Open a payment at the processor for a session Core created; the session id is the idempotency key at the processor.
methods.agent_reason: the owner reaches payments through Core's own payment tools (payments_list, payment_detail, payment_decide, payment_methods, payment_method_set); this hook is Core-to-plugin plumbing beneath them

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Give money back for a refund Core recorded; the refund id is the idempotency key, and an error means its fate is unknown, so Core asks again.
methods.agent_reason: the owner reaches payments through Core's own payment tools (payments_list, payment_detail, payment_decide, payment_methods, payment_method_set); this hook is Core-to-plugin plumbing beneath them

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Read a payment's state at the processor and report it, for a session whose news did not arrive.
methods.agent_reason: the owner reaches payments through Core's own payment tools (payments_list, payment_detail, payment_decide, payment_methods, payment_method_set); this hook is Core-to-plugin plumbing beneath them

methods.name: saved.forget
methods.description: Let go of a kept payment method at the processor; an error means it may still be kept, so Core asks again.
methods.agent_reason: the owner reaches payments through Core's own payment tools (payments_list, payment_detail, payment_decide, payment_methods, payment_method_set); this hook is Core-to-plugin plumbing beneath them

methods.name: session.confirm
methods.description: Ask the plugin that wanted the payment whether it still wants it, before Core resolves it.
methods.agent_reason: the owner reaches payments through Core's own payment tools (payments_list, payment_detail, payment_decide, payment_methods, payment_method_set); this hook is Core-to-plugin plumbing beneath them

methods.name: session.updated
methods.description: Tell the plugin that wanted the payment its latest state; repeated until it returns nil.
methods.agent_reason: the owner reaches payments through Core's own payment tools (payments_list, payment_detail, payment_decide, payment_methods, payment_method_set); this hook is Core-to-plugin plumbing beneath them

methods.name: refund.updated
methods.description: Tell the plugin that asked for a refund its latest state; repeated until it returns nil.
methods.agent_reason: the owner reaches payments through Core's own payment tools (payments_list, payment_detail, payment_decide, payment_methods, payment_method_set); this hook is Core-to-plugin plumbing beneath them

methods.name: dispute.updated
methods.description: Tell the plugin that took the payment about a dispute or chargeback on it; repeated until it returns nil.
methods.agent_reason: the owner reaches payments through Core's own payment tools (payments_list, payment_detail, payment_decide, payment_methods, payment_method_set); this hook is Core-to-plugin plumbing beneath them
